proposal.observation: Round 2 failed before producing any SAM metrics after setting processing.y_bounds, so its zero proxy is a pipeline failure rather than evidence about segmentation quality. Round 1 remained operational and showed that relaxing detection increased real detections from 0.7 to 0.8, reduced fallback from 0.3 to 0.2, and preserved the exact 10-ring count, although its four-parameter intervention was slightly worse overall by 0.0012. Orientation, denoise retention, and depth coverage remain healthy.
proposal.failure_mode: Residual partial f_missing_lines with an over-broad prior intervention: faint oblique joints still motivate limited relaxation, but changing binarization, line bridging, and fallback behavior together perturbed downstream mask balance.
proposal.rationale: Use the successful direction from round 1 conservatively while removing its confounded changes. A small reduction of only the oblique Hough threshold from the T1/T2 prior of 50 to 45 should recover some faint real joint lines without the stronger noise admission and line reconnection caused by the round-1 binary-threshold, max-gap, and horizontal-threshold changes. This keeps the known-working SAM configuration, denoising, vertical ring detection, and locked unfolding untouched.
